principles: Only deterministic rule-bound facts from Production-authorized sources may auto-fill Production evidence_features.
TSL, JMA current-state shadow, same-day derived shadow and point-in-time population seed remain isolated from Production features unless separately promoted.
Existing request feature classifications are never silently overwritten.
Missing evidence remains missing. UNKNOWN is not WEAK and is not neutral 50.
Per-index coverage and DCR resolvability are measured before Production base-index materialization.

weight_load_fit.condition: All active official JRA runners have the same assigned_weight.
weight_load_fit.rationale: Deterministic equal-load fact; no relative burden advantage is asserted.
